water_source.filter: Eau potable + Ouvert; fountains and drinking taps, excluding showers

alignment.method: Piecewise affine interpolation within reference control hull, plus reviewed City-object placements for six shoreline records; no general extrapolation
alignment.accuracy_note: Illustrated positions are approximate. Holdout errors compare schematic reference locations, not surveyed fountain positions. City map links provide the authoritative coordinates.

water_source.status_note: One saved municipal register snapshot; no live flow monitoring or automatic polling

provenance.method: Native SVG leader-dot centres and one forest-direction arrow tip; overlapping icons use original badge centres with minimal further spacing. Exact anchors retain callouts. No geographic projection or invented location coordinates.

notes: WATER POINTS uses a municipal snapshot explicitly marked Eau potable and Ouvert. Closed, non-potable, untested-water points and showers are excluded. This is not live availability.
New drinking-water markers are calibrated approximate positions on the illustration. Their City map links retain authoritative geographic locations; original PDF anchors are unchanged.
Illustrated-map positions preserve the source artwork, rather than claiming surveyed geographic accuracy.
SWIMMING replaces FORESTS in the display cycle: three pools (source water references 7, 8, 9) and three designated lake sites (6, 10, 11). The original 107 records remain in reference_scenes.
Swimming locations and facility types are reference information, not live opening status or a claim about current bathing conditions.
